statements.text: For the 2025 general transfers, employees who have completed five (5) years of service at a station as on 30-04-2025 shall be transferred compulsorily.
statements.quote: Employees who have completed five (5) years of service at a station as on 30-04-2025 shall be transferred compulsorily.

statements.text: The station period for the 2025 transfers is computed with reference to the total continuous service.
statements.quote: The station period shall be computed with reference to the total continuous service at a

statements.text: Periods of leave not exceeding six months shall be counted towards the station period, while periods of deputation outside the Department shall not be counted.
statements.quote: Periods of leave not exceeding six months shall be counted towards the station period. Periods of deputation outside the Department shall not be counted.

statements.text: Where an employee has been transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices shall be treated as service at one station.
statements.quote: Where an employee has been transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices shall be treated as service at one station.
